description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Packers coach Matt LaFleur said Josh Jacobs could return to practice next week.
items.impact: LaFleur clarified that it wouldn't be till later in the week. Jacobs has been absent from practice due to a groin injury.
items.title: Josh Jacobs (groin) could return next week

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The NFL has suspended Titans CB Nazeeh Johnson six regular season games for performance-enhancing substance policy violation.
items.impact: Johnson can still participate in all preseason activities. He will be eligible for reinstatement on October 19.
items.title: Nazeeh Johnson suspended six games by NFL

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The NFL has suspended DE Dorance Armstrong Jr. for the season opener.
items.impact: Armstrong is still eligible to participate in all preseason activities. He'll be eligible for reinstatement on September 14.
items.title: Dorance Armstrong Jr. suspended for the season opener

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Bills DT Phidarian Mathis has been suspended for three games for violating the NFL's Substances of Abuse Policy.
items.impact: Mathis is still eligible to participate in preseason practices and games. He'll be eligible to return September 28.
items.title: Phidarian Mathis suspended three games

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Eagles signed LB Brandon George.
items.impact: George spent last season on injured reserve with the Chiefs. He will compete for a depth role in the Eagles linebacker room.
items.title: Brandon George signs with Eagles

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Falcons DE James Pearce Jr. is being suspended eight regular-season games for violating the NFL's personal conduct policy.
items.impact: Pearce was arrested in February after a domestic dispute. He will miss the first eight games of the season.
items.title: James Pearce Jr. suspended eight games by NFL

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Kurtis Rourke was released from a local hospital Thursday night.
items.impact: Rourke left Thursday's preseason game against the Titans in the first half. He was having trouble breathing, head coach Kyle Shanahan said after the game. The initial X-rays he underwent did not show a broken rib.
items.title: Kurtis Rourke (ribs) released from hospital

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Cardinals head coach Mike LaFleur said he has 'no concern' over the rib injury that Carson Beck is dealing with.
items.impact: The injury kept Beck out of Thursday's preseason game against the Raiders. He should be good to go for next week's preseason game.
items.title: Carson Beck not dealing with serious rib injury

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Raiders coach Klint Kubiak said "it's his job to lose" when asked about Kirk Cousins' status as QB1 following Thursday's preseason game.
items.impact: Cousins played on the opening drive on Thursday, which resulted in a touchdown pass to Michael Mayer. He remains highly likely to open the season as the starter for Las Vegas.
items.title: Kirk Cousins: Starting job is 'his to lose' per HC Klint Kubiak

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Raiders coach Klint Kubiak said he expects Dont'e Thornton to return at some point in the preseason.
items.impact: Thornton has missed the last week of practice and the Raiders preseason opener due to an undisclosed reason/ injury. He is likely to remain off the fantasy radar.
items.title: Dont'e Thornton Jr. (undisclosed) to return at some point during preseason

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Saints coach Kellen Moore said Jordyn Tyson is dealing with a right hamstring injury.
items.impact: Tyson left practice early on Thursday with the injury. It is believed to be a different hamstring injury than what the rookie was previously dealing with. Moore said the possibility of Tyson missing Week 1 can't be ruled out. Not a good sign for the rookie right now.
items.title: Jordyn Tyson dealing with right hamstring injury

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Terrell Burgess left Thursday's practice early due to a lower body injury.
items.impact: Burgess will continue to be further evaluated into Friday.
items.title: Terrell Burgess exits practice early Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Rayshaun Benny returned to practice at Ravens training camp on Thursday.
items.impact: Benny had been away from practice due to an undisclosed injury.
items.title: Rayshaun Benny back at practice Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Browns waived CB Tyron Herring with an injury designation.
items.impact: Herring will figure to seek another opportunity when he is cleared.
items.title: Tyron Herring waived by Browns

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Rashod Bateman returned to practice for Baltimore on Thursday.
items.impact: Bateman had missed the previous two days of practice for the Ravens.
items.title: Rashod Bateman back at practice Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Texans and Sione Takitaki reached an agreement on an injury settlement.
items.impact: Takitaki was recently placed on injured reserve by Houston with a hamstring injury.
items.title: Sione Takitaki reaches injury settlement with Texans

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: K.J. Henry has cleared waivers and reverted to the 49ers' injured reserve list.
items.impact: Henry was previously waived by San Francisco. He'll be out for the season unless the two sides reach an injury settlement.
items.title: K.J. Henry clears waivers, reverts back to IR

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Jets and Eric Watts reached an agreement on an injury settlement.
items.impact: Watts had been waived by the Jets earlier this week.
items.title: Eric Watts reaches injury settlement with Jets

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: David Long received an injury settlement from the Giants.
items.impact: Long had been placed on injured reserve in late July.
items.title: David Long Jr. reaches injury settlement with Giants

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Rams signed LB Monty Rice.
items.impact: Rice will compete for a depth role in the linebacker room for the Rams.
items.title: Monty Rice signs with Rams

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Broncos signed OL Lecitus Smith.
items.impact: Smith appeared in one game with the Packers last season. He'll compete for a depth role on the offensive line for Denver.
items.title: Lecitus Smith signs with Broncos

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Broncos placed C Michael Deiter on injured reserve.
items.impact: Deiter suffered a season-ending quad injury in practice earlier this week.
items.title: Michael Deiter (quad) placed on IR

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Steelers placed DL Logan Lee on injured reserve.
items.impact: Lee's season ends early unless an injury settlement is reached.
items.title: Logan Lee placed on IR

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Steelers signed LB Elandon Roberts.
items.impact: Roberts will compete for a depth role in the Steelers linebacker room.
items.title: Elandon Roberts signs with Steelers

title: Fantasy Player News
